desc:
⚽ Soccer… but with CARS! 🏎️💨

Get behind the wheel, hit the boost, and score epic goals in this action-packed car soccer game! 🚀 Challenge your friends, compete against other players, and show off your driving skills. Make insane saves, land powerful shots, and dominate the field!

👑 Can YOU become the King of the Field?

🔥 HOW TO PLAY

- 🏁 Head to a Duel Pad to join a match!
- 🏎️ Drive, jump, and boost to hit the ball!
- 🥅 Score goals and defend your net!
- 🏆 Score more goals than your opponents to WIN!

⭐ JOIN OUR COMMUNITY
Join our group and share your ideas for future updates, new features, and more!

🎮 PLAY ON ANY DEVICE!

- 🖥️ PC: WASD + Mouse
- 📱 Mobile: On-screen controls
- 🎮 Console: Controller

⚡ Start your engines, hit the field, and prove you're the best! ⚽🏆
